jobs.prompt: Create production 2D sprite animation artwork, not a concept poster. IDENTITY LOCK: exact same cute six-year-old Z-God from reference1: chestnut brown shoulder-length hair with flipped ends, one large pink side bow, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks, pink knit sweater with yellow star centered on chest, raspberry pleated skirt, opaque lavender leggings, pink high-top sneakers. Child proportions, short limbs, large head, small child build. Keep all clothes and colors identical in every frame. Match original black ink contour and textured colored pencil/crayon rendering. Reference2 is a transparent seed canvas for identity and scale guidance only. ALL poses face RIGHT, side-scroller three-quarter side view, visible friendly face. Deliver entire sequence IN ONE IMAGE, exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 16 separate full-body sprites, equal invisible square cells, square canvas ideally 2048x2048. Read LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM. Each sprite comfortably inside its cell with at least 15% transparent padding on all sides; no shared strokes or touching adjacent sprites. Consistent head size, limb lengths and body scale throughout. Complete bows, hands, shoes and any held equipment within each cell, no cropping. Native TRANSPARENT background, no grid lines, text, numbers, labels, shadows, scenery or watermarks. Small tightly connected effects only, no detached sparkles floating outside poses. The exact requested poses follow.  Frames 1-8 (first TWO ROWS): eight distinct phases of a smooth complete RIGHTWARD RUN cycle, right foot contact, down/compression, passing, lift, left foot contact, down/compression, passing, lift. Genuine alternating leg and arm positions, hair and skirt secondary follow-through, stable head scale. Frames 9-12 (THIRD ROW): jump takeoff bent knees, rising knees tucked, apex balanced, falling feet extending ready to land. Keep all full-body drawings standing vertically in their own cell, don't simulate altitude by moving the whole sprite inside cell. Frame 13 (FOURTH ROW column1): upright relaxed idle. Frames 14-16 (last three cells): attack anticipation, full extension impact, follow-through recovery. EMPTY HANDS in all poses. Run freely with natural opposite arm swing. Attacks are a playful but powerful short right-handed punch with a small golden star glow touching her fist. No weapons or costume changes.
